items.name: Complete Elimination of Public/Deterministic Fallback Capability
items.description: Scanned all repository codebase, tests, specifications, runbooks, and artifacts for any reference to deterministic capability bypasses. Verified 0 references remain.

items.name: Mandatory Capability Secret Requirement (>= 16 chars)
items.description: Verifies that token generation and token validation strictly fail-closed if capabilitySecret is undefined, empty, whitespace-only, or shorter than 16 characters.

items.name: Full 64-Hex (256-bit) HMAC-SHA256 Signatures
items.description: Verifies that all tokens contain full 64-hex lowercase HMAC-SHA256 signatures over the canonical multi-parameter payload and verify with constant-time equality.

items.name: 8-Parameter Cryptographic Binding & Tamper Detection
items.description: Verifies that altering any of approvedBy, targetPhase, environmentTarget, maxBudgetUsd, approvalTimestamp, specificationVersion, sourceCommitSha, or runNonce causes immediate signature rejection.

items.name: Strict Gregorian Calendar Date Validation
items.description: Verifies rejection of non-existent dates (20260231, 20260229 in non-leap year, 20260431, 20261301) and enforcement of 3600-second expiration window.

items.name: Retry & Fallback Accounting Against Provider Quotas
items.description: Verifies that retries and fallbacks count as full provider requests against the 7-per-provider and 14-total request quotas, preventing quota overruns.

items.name: Strict HTTPS Endpoints with Disallowed Redirects
items.description: Verifies outbound HTTP request configuration uses redirect: 'error' and strict allowlist enforcement for api.deepseek.com and generativelanguage.googleapis.com.

items.name: Capability Secret Stripping from Evidence Outputs
items.description: Verifies capabilitySecret is scrubbed from humanApproval metadata before saving execution artifacts or returning runner results.

items.name: Live Canary Execution Runbook v1.1.0 Synchronization
items.description: Reconciled CANARY_EXECUTION_RUNBOOK.md with all new HMAC-SHA256 requirements, CLI invocation arguments, 17 kill switches, and operator workflows.
